title: pteridella hastata
intro: Pteridella hastata, commonly known as the hastate fern, is a type of plant in the fern family that is native to tropical regions. The hastate fern has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Pteridella hastata include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it effective in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the hastate fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
